parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the stream belongs. You can view the AppName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The streaming domain of the streamer.
> - When you specify DomainName, make sure that the domain name is a live streaming domain name and that you have the permissions to manage the domain name.

parameters.name: OnlyStream
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return only specified fields. Valid values:  

- **yes**: Only the DomainName, AppName, StreamName, and PublishTime fields are returned.  

- **no** (default): All fields are returned.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 3000. Default value: 2000.

parameters.name: QueryType
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use fuzzy match for the stream name. Valid values:

- **fuzzy** (default): fuzzy match.

- **strict**: exact match.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The stream name. Only a single StreamName can be specified. You can view the StreamName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

parameters.name: StreamType
parameters.description:
The stream type. Valid values:  

- **all** (default): all streams.
  
- **raw**: raw streams.
  
- **trans**: transcoded streams.
